name: ModelVariant837_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant837_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a glow with a spinning ring and streaks gathers on a model part; at the launch time it flies to a point in front of the opposing slot, shedding motes and orbiting sparks, where it bursts into a flash, a quartered glow, scattered sparks, beams and expanding bursts while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the ring, streaks, motes and sparks and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 4 once when the glow reaches the opposing slot, 1 once on the next frame as the flash starts, 2 once the burst colour has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-854 and 951 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
